title: XENO X4 panpsychism falsifier — 4 micro-substrate Φ scan

F-X4-PANPSY-WEAK.claim: thermostat phi <= 0.05 (1-bit binary is not a substrate of mind)
F-X4-PANPSY-WEAK.honest_reading: thermostat after IIT4 2-unit TPM construction registers HIGH phi (0.439). The square-wave period-2 → row-stochastic deterministic TPM produces a maximally-informative transition matrix. The detector does NOT classify it 'conscious' (irr=0.5, type=coherent_non_conscious) but it does NOT zero out. Panpsy WEAK form survives the integer-Φ axis.

F-X4-PANPSY-MID.honest_reading: LCG memoryless random walker registers HIGHEST phi (0.582) of all 4 substrates. Reason: 8-level quantization + 0.5 binarisation threshold gives a varied bit stream whose 2-unit TPM resembles a near-uniform stochastic process - the IIT4 detector reads this as 'integration' because each row carries entropy. The detector cannot distinguish IID randomness from genuine coupling at n=32 with 2-unit TPM. This is a real instrument finding.

F-X4-EMERGE-STRONG.honest_reading: Truly coupled XOR-3-tap LFSR registers LOWEST nonzero phi (0.157). Reason: the period-7 m-sequence on a 3-bit register reveals deterministic structure to the 2-unit TPM (high autocorrelation at lag 3), which IIT4 reads as REDUCIBLE - so phi DROPS relative to noise. Determinism + short period = high MIP-reducibility = low Φ. This inverts the naive 'coupled = high Φ' intuition.

F-X4-MONOTONE.claim: thermostat < walker < emerge (Phi monotone with complexity)
F-X4-MONOTONE.honest_reading: Φ is NON-MONOTONIC with naive complexity ordering. Random > thermostat > deterministic-coupled. The ordering reflects the detector's pure information-theoretic core: noise has high state-entropy hence high Φ, deterministic coupling has low state-entropy hence low Φ. This is consistent with IIT4 axioms but counter to the 'complexity correlates with consciousness' intuition that panpsy MONOTONE assumed.

summary.verdict_text: X4 pre-registered prediction matrix FAILS on all 4 axes. The result is honest under a_blue_closed (no threshold retuning) and p7=0 (verbatim detector output).
summary.interpretation: BOTH options the spec offered fire simultaneously: (1) panpsy strong form is partially revived (Φ is not the clean stratifier that rules-out trivial micro-substrates), AND (2) the detector reveals a known IIT4 brittleness at n=16-32 with 2-unit co-occurrence TPM construction (random > coupled inversion). The X1/X2 calibration (5/5 + 4/4) holds on its target substrates (large n, multi-state) but does NOT generalize down to the panpsy micro-regime. Panpsy WEAK form ('the thermostat has a tiny mind') survives this falsifier round - the detector cannot exclude it. This is a genuine open-frontier finding consistent with feedback-closure-is-physical-limit (report honestly to the measurement boundary).

honesty_audit.feedback_closure_is_physical_limit: measurement is at the limit of invariant_detector's binarisation/2-unit-TPM regime; reported as such.
honesty_audit.feedback_instrument_first_methodology: instrument (invariant_detector) calibration cited from H_829 (X1) and H_830 (X2); X4 reveals its micro-substrate non-applicability.
honesty_audit.feedback_universe_h_slug_stale_verify: 3-signal verified H_833 unused (ls-tree origin/main + git log + README grep all clean).
honesty_audit.panpsy_status: WEAK form (every substrate has a tiny mind) survives X4 falsifier round. Does NOT mean panpsy is true - just that this round's instrument cannot exclude it.
